buffs.description:
• Increases Agent Anomaly Buildup Rate by 30% and Disorder DMG by 40%.

buffs.description: • Agent ATK increases by 20%, Decibel Generation Rate increases by 20%. Upon launching an Ultimate, Agent ATK increases by an additional 15% for 15s. Ultimate DMG increases by 40%, Daze dealt increases by 20%, and Anomaly Buildup increases by 20%.

buffs.name: Interrupt
buffs.description:
• Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, EX Special Attack, and Dash Attack DMG increases by 30%.
• After triggering a Perfect Dodge or Perfect Assist, increases all squad members' ATK by 10% and CRIT DMG by 10% for 15s. Stacks up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

sides.description: • When inflicting an Attribute Anomaly or Disorder on a boss enemy, all squad members gain Laser Focus, which stacks up to 6 times. When Sacrifice: Bringer attacks with his Sacrificial Knife, all squad members' Laser Focus stacks will be reset.
sides.performance: • Successfully interrupting a chant grants 2000 Performance Points. A maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be obtained.

sides.description: • Boss enemies gain 1 stack of Battle-Hardened every 10s, increasing their DMG dealt by 20% and stacking up to 3 times. When inflicting Attribute Anomaly, removes 1 stack of Battle-Hardened and increases their DMG taken by 15% for 20s.
sides.performance: • Successfully inflicting Attribute Anomaly on enemies grants 150 Performance Points. A maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be obtained.

sides.description: • DMG dealt by Boss enemies increases by 25%. When a clone is destroyed or when the main body is stunned, 1/5 stacks of On Thin Ice is inflicted on Boss enemies respectively. On Thin Ice stacks will be reset when the enemy recovers from Stun.

• Increases Agent Anomaly Buildup Rate by 25% and Anomaly Proficiency by 40.
• When an enemy suffers an Attribute Anomaly, Agents recover 500 additional Decibels and ATK increases by 30% for 15s. The Decibel recovery effect can trigger once every 15s.

buffs.name: Break Through
buffs.description:
• Agent Sheer DMG increases by 15%. When Agents with Rupture specialty hit enemies with attacks, ignore 20% of the target's All-DMG RES.
• After activating an EX Special Attack, Agent Fire DMG increases by 40% for 15s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

buffs.name: Tempering Body
buffs.description:
• Agents deal 20% more DMG and attacks ignore 10% of enemy All-DMG RES.
• Attack specialty Agents' ATK increases by 20%, Basic Attack DMG increases by 40%, and ignore 20% of enemy DEF.

sides.description:
• Wandering Hunter's Base DEF increases by 40% in Miasmic Field; when an Agent hits Wandering Hunter with Assist Follow-Up or Dodge Counter, 1 stack of Wavering is applied. Wavering can stack up to 5 times and lasts 15 seconds. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
• When an Agent's attacks hit Wandering Hunter, for each stack of Wavering, the Agent's Sheer DMG is increased by 7%.
sides.performance: • During the hide-and-seek phase, using Perception Technique to break Drowned Ideal Lucia's true form will grant 3000 Performance Points; Exposing his true form and activating Defensive Assist or Assist Follow-Up against Wandering Hunter will grant 2000 Performance Points, up to a maximum of 5000 Performance Points.
sides.misc: • Suitable for Agents with Rupture specialty.

sides.description: • When Sobek and The Thrall alternate turns, The Thrall gains 1 stack of Contract and 1 stack of Self-Sacrifice. Contract and Self-Sacrifice can stack up to 3 times. Each stack of Contract increases All-Attribute Anomaly RES by 15%, each stack of Self-Sacrifice increases Stun DMG Multiplier by 10%. When The Thrall is Stunned, CRIT DMG taken increases by 50%.
sides.performance: • When Agents inflict Weakened on Sobek and The Thrall, 1500 Performance Points will be awarded. When an Agent eliminates Sobek, 2000 Performance Points will be awarded. Up to a maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be earned.
sides.misc: • Suitable for Agents with Stun specialty.

sides.description: • When inflicting an Attribute Anomaly or Disorder on a boss enemy, all squad members gain 1 stack of Laser Focus, stacking up to 6 times. Each stack of Laser Focus increases the Agent's ATK by 8%. With at least 3 stacks of Laser Focus, inflicting an Attribute Anomaly will increase its duration by 5s. When Sacrifice: Bringer attacks with his Sacrificial Knife, all squad members' Laser Focus stacks will be reset.
sides.performance: • Successfully interrupting a chant grants 2000 Performance Points. A maximum of 5000 Performance Points can be obtained.

buffs.name: Dream Delusion
buffs.description:
• Agent Anomaly Proficiency increases by 40.
• When inflicting Attribute Anomaly on enemies, their DEF is reduced by 10%, and Agent Anomaly DMG against them increases by 20% for 10 seconds. Repeated triggers reset the duration.

buffs.name: Sonata
buffs.description:
• Agent Decibel Generation Rate increases by 20%.
• Ultimates and EX Special Attacks ignore 20% of DMG RES on hit. After an Ultimate hits enemies, Agent Ultimate and EX Special Attack DMG increase by 50% for 30s, repeated triggers reset the duration.
